title: Femtoengineering
description: Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

puzzle.goal: A probe beam scatters off a tiny object whose charge is spread out with density ρ over a volume V, transferring momentum ħq. The scattered amplitude is the point-like one times a factor that adds up the phase each piece of the charge contributes. Write that factor, normalised to total charge Q.
puzzle.name: Form factor (Fourier transform of the charge distribution)
puzzle.form: 1 / Q * iiint ( ρ * exp ( i * ( vec ( q ) · vec ( r ) ) ) , V )
puzzle.ask: The form factor shows structure only once q ≈ 2π/d, i.e. when the probe's wavelength reaches the size d. Find the photon energy E = hc/d needed to resolve a structure of d = @{d} fm (h in MeV·s, c in fm/s).
puzzle.method: Each volume element at r scatters with an extra phase q·r; integrate the phase factor weighted by the density and divide by the total.
